job.job_description:
AI Engineer (Python, AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, RAG)




Location: Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Kochi, Kolkata, NCR/Delhi


Experience: 6-10 Years

Virtual Interview: 6th Aug





Job Description

We are looking for experienced AI Engineers with strong expertise in Python, AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered applications and scalable machine learning solutions.





Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
Build and optimize RAG-based applications using vector databases and LLMs.
Develop Agentic AI workflows and autonomous AI systems.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and monitor Large Language Models (LLMs).
Create scalable APIs and backend services using Python.
Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into AI-driven solutions.
Ensure model performance, security, scalability, and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the development lifecycle.



Required Skills

Strong programming experience in Python.
Hands-on experience in AI/ML algorithms and model development.
Experience working with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Good knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agentic AI frameworks and AI orchestration tools.
Knowledge of LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face or similar platforms.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Understanding of MLOps, model deployment, and monitoring.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.




If you are interested in this opportunity and available to attend the virtual interview on 6th August, kindly apply at the earliest.

Post receiving your application, I will connect with you for data collection and discuss the further steps in the hiring process.
